reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes), wet

description.lithology: Dark grey to black, medium-grained metamorphic rock with a mottled light grey to white patchy appearance. The dark groundmass is fine to medium grained and shows a weak to moderate foliation / gneissic fabric with irregular light-coloured quartz +/- feldspar patches and discontinuous white veinlets. The core is cylindrical, NQ-size appearance, with a red orientation line marked on each piece.

anomalies.explanation: Core is broken into several pieces with visible fractures and chipped / missing ends, e.g. right end of the top piece and right end of the second piece, and a truncated left/right end on the third and fourth pieces.
Multiple discontinuous white quartz-rich patches and thin white veinlets are visible throughout the run, most prominent in the second, third and bottom pieces.
